businesses.business: investment management holding company (boutique asset managers)

offering_description.value: Holds majority equity stakes in a group of independent boutique investment management firms and provides them with strategic, distribution and operational support. Those affiliates manage investment strategies for institutional investors, financial intermediaries and individuals, and earn fees on assets managed.

primary_services.value: investment management; mutual fund and ETF management; separate account management; alternative strategies; private equity and real asset fund management

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors such as pension funds, endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, and financial intermediaries; B2C: individual and high-net-worth investors via funds and managed accounts

end_markets.value: asset management; institutional investing; wealth management; retirement savings

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset-based management fees from affiliates' assets under management; commissions or management fees: performance fees on alternative and some other strategies
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes equity in boutique investment firms and sells their strategies to institutions, intermediaries and individuals

geography_served.value: global: US-headquartered with affiliates and clients across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: multiple boutique managers across equities, alternatives, private markets and multi-asset strategies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: AMG distribution teams and affiliate sales to institutional investors and consultants; partners / resellers: financial intermediaries, advisors, wealth platforms and retail fund distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment advisers and funds subject to SEC, FCA and other securities regulators
